task.question: What position is V. D. Satheesan elected to in Kerala in May 2026?
task.evidence: 14 May – V. D. Satheesan is elected as the Chief Minister of Kerala.

answer:
Based on the search results, V. D. Satheesan was elected as the leader of the Congress Legislature Party following the 2026 Kerala Legislative Assembly election. On May 14, 2026, he was announced as the Chief Minister-designate of Kerala.

FINAL: Chief Minister-designate of Kerala (leader of the Congress Legislature Party)
